dialler for AI agents, Partner Academy in your own learning system, reseller branding on training and screens, six more industry templates, and installs on Red Hat family servers.

Partner dialler: a partner's AI agents (through the API or the Yaxxa MCP server) can set up and run diallers: campaigns, lists, outcomes, callbacks, and publishing. Each key keeps to what it was given and can only be tightened, never loosened; the guide covers switching MCP on.

Partner Academy: resellers write their own courses; Partner Academy courses in your own learning system (LTI 1.3, SCORM off by default); training shows the reseller's brand.

Branded training and screens: help guides and the clients' Academy use neutral wording (no Yaxxa or Orchestrator names), ready for resellers' own brands. A reseller's staff and clients see the reseller's company name instead of Yaxxa on every screen (for example ITEC Omni, ITEC AI).

Industry templates: ready-made sets for BPO and outsourcing, banking and fintech, healthcare and medical aid, retail and e-commerce, energy and utilities, and logistics and courier, each with queues, flows, service levels and scripts.

Accessibility, second package: longer key-press waits and more patient AI agents for callers who need them, agent alerts, live captions and themes on the agent desk, and a WCAG 2.2 AA audit with fixes to contrast, focus and the skip link. Off until your plan includes it and it is switched on.

Red Hat family servers: a new server can be installed or joined on RHEL, Rocky Linux and AlmaLinux 9 and 10.

Agent schedule: an agent sees the shifts worked in the last six weeks, and can download a calendar file of their coming shifts for Outlook.

Outbound carrier per number: an outbound call goes out on the carrier of the caller number it presents, so a number is no longer refused because the call left on another carrier. Numbers without a carrier set go out as before.

Fixes: when a mailbox Test fails because the provider needs Microsoft or Google sign-in, the Sign in buttons now show under the result. The backup before an update no longer trips over a test run's temporary databases."}
